facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4102, HX-4120 and M-4102 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 14 December 2005 a near hit was recorded on P-4102, HX-4120 and M-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
